Amidophosphoribosyltransferase.subject: Horticulture - Fruit & Vegetable Production
Amidophosphoribosyltransferase.question: A_____ is a member of the purine/pyrimidine phosphoribosyltransferase family
Amidophosphoribosyltransferase.fact: Amidophosphoribosyltransferase (ATase), also called glutamine phosphoribosylpyrophosphate amidotransferase (GPAT), is an enzyme responsible for catalyzing the conversion of 5-phosphoribosyl-1-pyrophosphate (PRPP) into 5-phosphoribosyl-1-amine (PRA), using the amine group from a glutamine side-chain. ATase is a member of the purine/pyrimidine phosphoribosyltransferase family.

Amidophosphoribosyltransferase.question: The ammonia released by the first reaction is then transferred to the active site of the phosphoribosyltransferase domain via a 20 Å channel, where it then binds to _____ to form PRA
